how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-valley-of-trials-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:5843:details:0: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!
rows.quest:5843:details:1: As special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to ⟦E11⟧ in the ⟦E12⟧. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.
rows.quest:5843:details:2: Thanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
rows.quest:5843:progress:0: Hello! It is a pleasure to meet you!⟦6⟧⟦7⟧I see you have a special voucher. Give it to me and I will offer you something in exchange.
rows.quest:5843:completion:0: You are indeed a special hero, ⟦8⟧. We welcome you to the world of ⟦E13⟧, and offer you one of these unique gifts!
rows.quest:788:obj:0: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to ⟦E1⟧ at the Den.
rows.quest:788:details:0: The first order of business will be to put a little strength in your backbone. I could send you out to the ⟦E14⟧ to hunt kodo, but well, in all honesty, you're more useful to us alive than dead.
rows.quest:788:details:1: I believe you would find a good match with the mottled boars you'll find to the north of here.
rows.quest:788:progress:0: I hope you haven't returned to try and convince me that you have completed your task, ⟦9⟧? No, of course not. I would think better of you.
rows.quest:788:completion:0: Hmmm, not bad, ⟦10⟧. But don't let it get to your head...you'll fight tougher than boars in your career.
rows.quest:788:completion:1: Nonetheless, you've proven yourself well, and your next trial will be against a considerably more dangerous opponent, so you'll need some extra protection.
rows.quest:789:obj:0: Get 10 ⟦E16⟧ Tails for ⟦E1⟧ in the Den.
rows.quest:789:details:0: Powerful warrior and awkward novice alike have fallen to the venomous sting of the scorpid. You will find large numbers of scorpids northwest of here. Bring me ten of their tails as proof of your prowess in battle.
rows.quest:789:details:1: The antidote for their sting is actually made from venom extracted from their stingers. We keep large quantities of antidote for scorpid venom on hand to heal young bloods just like you...
rows.quest:789:details:2: But I'm sure you won't be needing any of that, will you?
rows.quest:789:progress:0: The carapace of a scorpid isn't so thick that the strength of a determined ⟦11⟧ will be deterred. Strike strongly and without doubt, and the scorpids should prove easy prey.
rows.quest:789:completion:0: There is an important lesson that you must take away from fighting scorpids. The smallest or largest of opponents can still send you to your doom. In fierce combat, any number of things can prove your downfall.
rows.quest:789:completion:1: I have no more to teach you, ⟦12⟧. You have done well, and I will watch your progress with interest.
rows.quest:4402:obj:0: Bring ⟦E19⟧ 10 Cactus Apples. You remember him saying that they could be found near cactuses.
rows.quest:4402:details:0: It sure gets hot out here in the ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:4402:details:2: If only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.
rows.quest:4402:details:3: I'll tell you what, ⟦13⟧. If you bring me 10 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.
rows.quest:4402:progress:0: Have you finished collecting cactus apples?
rows.quest:4402:completion:0: Wonderful, ⟦14⟧! As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise plus a little something extra.
rows.quest:792:details:0: I trust the ⟦E12⟧ will teach you much, young ⟦15⟧.
rows.quest:792:details:1: I was sent to the Valley to guide you, but I have discovered a growing taint here...
rows.quest:792:details:2: BA group that calls itself the Burning Blade has a coven here in the ⟦E12⟧. They are skulking in a cave to the northeast, and their ⟦E20⟧ have spilled from its mouth to cause havoc.
rows.quest:792:details:3: As your first task against the Burning Blade, I bid you, defeat these familiars. Slay many and, if you survive, return to me.
rows.quest:792:progress:0: To prove yourself against the Burning Blade, you must first defeat its ⟦E20⟧. Return to me when you have done this.
rows.quest:792:completion:1: Although the ⟦E20⟧ were merely pets of the darker powers within the Burning Blade, your success against them foretells greater deeds ahead.
rows.quest:5441:obj:0: Use the ⟦E23⟧ on ⟦E24⟧ when they're sleeping. Wake up 5 peons, then return the ⟦E23⟧ to ⟦E25⟧ in the ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:5441:details:0: Cursed peons! They work hard gathering lumber from the trees of the valley, but they're always taking naps! I need someone to help keep the peons in line.
rows.quest:5441:details:1: You look like the right ⟦17⟧ for my task. Here, you take this blackjack and use it on any lazy peons you find sleeping on the job. A good smack will get them right back to work! Return the blackjack when you're done.
rows.quest:5441:progress:0: No good lazy...⟦18⟧⟦19⟧ Eh? Do you have my blackjack? Did you catch any peons sleeping on the job?!
rows.quest:5441:completion:0: Good, good. Maybe they'll think twice before slacking next time! Thanks for the help!
rows.quest:6394:details:0: ⟦20⟧, you are a dependable ⟦21⟧. Can I count on you for another task?
rows.quest:6394:details:1: Some time ago I was surveying the cave to the north for minerals, and I left my favorite pick behind. When I later returned to retrieve it I found the cave was filled with vicious beasts! Will you go into the cave, the Burning Blade Coven, and get my pick?
rows.quest:6394:details:2: I left it in a chamber with waterfalls. My pick has a spell on it so you can see it in the dark, so you won't have to worry about finding it... just what's guarding it!
rows.quest:6394:progress:0: Have you entered the Burning Blade Coven, ⟦22⟧? Did you find my pick?
rows.quest:6394:completion:0: Great, you got it! Thanks a lot, ⟦23⟧. This is my favorite pick! Now if my peons ever finish chopping down these trees, maybe we can find a nice cave to mine!
rows.quest:790:obj:0: Kill ⟦E28⟧ and bring his claw back to ⟦E29⟧.
rows.quest:790:details:0: ⟦24⟧! I thought I would die out here with none to know of it. While I was hunting the scorpids of the Valley, I came across a particularly vicious-looking one. Hurling myself at it, I managed to inflict a massive blow to its claw before it closed around my leg.
rows.quest:790:details:1: I wasn't ready for its stinger though, and it sliced down and into my chest, cutting into my flesh and letting my blood. Please, you must kill the scorpid for me! My honor must be upheld! I fought it up on the plateau to the south.
rows.quest:790:progress:0: Ahhh... my father always said I would never amount to much, and here, lying beneath a tree as life seeps away, I'm afraid it looks like he was right.⟦25⟧⟦26⟧At least I wish to die knowing that my last enemy in life lays dead.
rows.quest:790:completion:0: My blow was not enough to kill him, but looking at the damage I inflicted gives me some small measure of pride. That small measure will be all I have to sustain myself if I die, and in that light, the short list of my life's accomplishments fills me with anger.
rows.quest:794:details:0: Through my divinations, I see that an item of power hides deep within the Burning Blade Coven, guarded by beasts and black magic.
rows.quest:794:details:1: It is called the ⟦E32⟧, and your next task is to find it and remove it from the coven.
rows.quest:794:details:2: But be wary, for the medallion may be possessed by an agent of the Burning Blade, and if so then the agent's power would be greater than the familiars you have already encountered.
rows.quest:794:details:3: Go, ⟦27⟧. You will find the coven in a cave, to the north and west.
rows.quest:794:progress:0: Is your task complete, ⟦28⟧? Do you have the ⟦E32⟧?
rows.quest:794:completion:1: Your efforts within the Burning Blade Coven are key in rooting out this cult in the ⟦E12⟧. But I fear they have further aims in our land.
rows.quest:794:completion:2: We have not seen the end of them.
rows.quest:804:obj:0: Bring the news of ⟦E29⟧'s plight to ⟦E1⟧ at the Den.
rows.quest:804:details:0: Seeing the deed you have done for me steels my heart. I cannot fall so easily! I must endure!
rows.quest:804:details:1: But it remains that I cannot make the trek back to the Den unassisted. Please, ⟦29⟧, return to the Den and tell ⟦E1⟧ of my situation. Perhaps he can help me.
rows.quest:804:completion:0: From your description of the beast, I believe you must be speaking of ⟦E28⟧! It is no wonder that ⟦E29⟧ was overtaken by it. Aid will be dispatched to him immediately, trouble yourself no more with ⟦E29⟧'s plight.
rows.quest:804:completion:1: However, I must say, I am most impressed to hear that you brought ⟦E28⟧ to death. It is a feat to be proud of, ⟦30⟧. And that you would fight for a stranger's honor, while other tasks occupied your time, your own honor is heightened.
rows.quest:805:details:0: Your trials against the Burning Blade are finished... here in the Valley. But I want you to report your findings.
rows.quest:805:details:1: Go to the troll village of Sen'jin and seek out ⟦E35⟧. Sen'jin Village is east out of the valley, then right at the fork.
rows.quest:805:details:2: Tell Gadrin of the Burning Blade, and that they have reached the ⟦E12⟧. Discover from him if they have yet reached Sen'jin.
rows.quest:805:details:3: Go, ⟦31⟧, and be swift. I fear the evil found in the Burning Blade Coven is but the herald of a larger threat...
rows.quest:805:completion:0: Hm... your report comes at a bad time. The Burning Blade is not seen here in Sen'jin, but their evil has taken seed off the coast, on the Echo Isles.
rows.quest:805:completion:1: The orcs are friends of the Darkspear Trolls. Honorable friends. We want to help the orcs, but... we need help too.⟦32⟧
